projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: Overall RAG status is not specified across all dimensions (Overall, Scope, Cost, Timeline, Quality, Talent, CSAT) for a Category 1 project in Build + SIT stage (EMS - RAG)
riskDescription.condition: If RAG assessment and weekly updates are not established
riskDescription.consequence: Executive visibility into project health will remain absent, preventing timely intervention and escalation when metrics deteriorate toward breach thresholds

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly RAG assessment across all dimensions with documented criteria and baseline status by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon executive escalation due to visibility gap, activate daily RAG reporting with steering committee review within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Already occurring - no RAG status exists despite Category 1 classification requiring enhanced governance. High impact as absence prevents executive decision-making and early warning signal generation for a project with active scope risk and aggressive timelines.

riskDescription.context: All seven SOW milestones marked 'Yet to Start' with no actual start or end dates recorded, despite project stage designated as Build + SIT and team created May 22, 2026, which is 2.5 months after project start date of March 1, 2026 (EMS - Milestones, Project Details)
riskDescription.condition: If milestone actuals are not updated to reflect true progress and recovery plan is not developed
riskDescription.consequence: Schedule slippage of 2-3 months will remain invisible in tracking systems, preventing accurate forecast of Development and Testing completion (scheduled June 15, 2026) and cascading delays to UAT (June 30, 2026) and Go-Live (July 15, 2026)

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Update all milestone actuals weekly with baseline correction and re-baseline Design Phase and Sprint 1-2 by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once milestone slippage exceeds two weeks, escalate to project board and activate fast-track recovery plan with extended hours within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Data integrity gap is already present - stage designation conflicts with milestone status. High impact as Design Phase (March 1-31, 2026) and Sprint 1 & 2 (April 1-30, 2026) scheduled dates have passed with no actuals recorded, indicating existing slippage.

riskDescription.context: Actual effort of 8.0 is 82.2% below baseline effort of 45.0, with team creation date of May 22, 2026 occurring 2.5 months after project start date of March 1, 2026 (EMS - Resources, Project Details)
riskDescription.condition: If effort variance is not closed to within 30% of baseline by April 15, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity will remain insufficient to complete Development and Testing by June 15, 2026, causing milestone slippage and compressing the already aggressive 15-day testing window

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Redistribute workload across existing team and track effort daily to close variance to 30% by April 15, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If effort remains below 70% of baseline by April 15, engage backup resources from circle team and escalate to leadership within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Extreme variance already exists with late team mobilization confirmed. High impact as gap directly prevents achievement of sprint velocity needed for Design Phase and Sprint 1 & 2 milestones, with no buffer in schedule to absorb delays.

riskDescription.context: Approximately 14 scope changes have been absorbed, equivalent to 0.75-1 sprint of additional effort, with active risk 857 indicating further scope additions are likely (EMS - Risks)
riskDescription.condition: If scope change control process with impact assessment and approval workflow is not implemented
riskDescription.consequence: Uncontrolled scope changes will consume an additional 1-2 sprints of effort, delaying Development and Testing completion beyond June 15, 2026 and cascading to UAT and Go-Live milestones

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal scope change control procedure with impact assessment and CR approval before work begins by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon additional scope change request, freeze new work and escalate to steering committee for timeline re-baseline within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Risk 857 is active with 'Likely' likelihood and no mitigation plan or due date. Historical pattern of 14 changes already absorbed strengthens probability. High impact as additional scope directly threatens critical 15-day Development/Testing window with zero buffer.

riskDescription.context: Active scope change risk 857 has mitigation status of 'Assessed' with mitigation plan stating 'mitigation needs to be arrived' and no due date specified (EMS - Risks)
riskDescription.condition: If specific mitigation plan with owner and due date is not established by March 31, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: Scope changes will continue without control mechanism, preventing accurate effort forecasting and milestone commitment for Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026)

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define scope change mitigation plan with owner assignment and due date in risk register by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If mitigation plan is not approved by April 7, escalate to project sponsor and activate change freeze protocol immediately.
risks.reasoning: Mitigation gap already exists - risk opened June 29, 2026 with no concrete plan developed. Medium impact as absence of mitigation enables continued scope additions but does not directly cause breach, though it amplifies schedule risk.

riskDescription.context: Development and Testing completion milestone scheduled for 15-day window (June 1-15, 2026) must accommodate functional, performance, accessibility, and security testing, with only 2 Ascenders covering Development, Functional Testing, and Regression Testing roles (EMS - Milestones, Resources)
riskDescription.condition: If testing capacity is not augmented or Development and Testing window is not extended by May 1, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: Testing will be incomplete or rushed, increasing defect leakage to UAT and production, potentially extending UAT beyond June 30, 2026 due to quality issues requiring rework

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Augment testing capacity with dedicated QA resources or extend Development and Testing window by two weeks by May 1, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of critical defects in UAT, activate backup testers and implement risk-based testing for critical flows within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Multiple signals converge - aggressive 15-day window, comprehensive testing scope, and limited testing resources with multi-role assignments. High impact as quality issues discovered in UAT directly delay Go-Live (July 15, 2026) with no schedule buffer.

riskDescription.context: UAT milestone scheduled for 15-day window (June 16-30, 2026) depends on Development and Testing completion by June 15, 2026, with no buffer between phases and client sign-off required (EMS - Milestones)
riskDescription.condition: If Development and Testing phase experiences any slippage or quality issues requiring rework
riskDescription.consequence: UAT start will be delayed and the 15-day window will be insufficient for user acceptance testing and client sign-off, causing UAT completion to extend beyond June 30, 2026 and delaying Go-Live

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly checkpoints with client for UAT readiness and prioritize critical-path functionality by May 15, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once UAT delay exceeds three days, activate phased delivery approach and escalate to client for revised Go-Live date within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Tight dependency chain with zero buffer and multiple upstream risks (effort variance, scope changes, testing capacity). High impact as UAT delay directly affects Go-Live (July 15, 2026) and compresses time to SOW end (November 30, 2026).

riskDescription.context: Go-Live milestone scheduled for July 1-15, 2026 depends on UAT completion by June 30, 2026, with SOW end date of November 30, 2026 and Hypercare scheduled through August 31, 2026 (EMS - Milestones, Project Details)
riskDescription.condition: If cumulative milestone slippage from Development/Testing and UAT phases occurs
riskDescription.consequence: Go-Live will be delayed beyond July 15, 2026 by 2-4 weeks, compressing Hypercare window and creating pressure on SOW end date commitment

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Monitor cumulative slippage weekly and prepare contingency Go-Live plan with phased rollout by June 1, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should Go-Live delay exceed one week, implement limited production rollout and communicate revised Hypercare timeline to stakeholders.
risks.reasoning: Dependent on upstream milestone performance with multiple contributing risk factors (scope changes, testing capacity, effort variance). High impact as Go-Live delay affects contractual commitment and Hypercare adequacy. Rated Possible as mitigation actions could prevent full cascade.

riskDescription.context: Project categorized as Category 1 with Infrastructure identified as primary bottleneck, with Infrastructure score of 1 indicating significant challenges in Private Cloud Azure deployment (EMS - Project Categorization)
riskDescription.condition: If Infrastructure readiness assessment and remediation are not completed by April 15, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: SIT environment instability will delay Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026), and UAT environment provisioning delays will compress UAT window (June 16-30, 2026)

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct Infrastructure readiness assessment for SIT, UAT, and Production environments with remediation plan by April 15, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should environment provisioning delay exceed one week, utilize alternative Azure environments and reprioritize non-dependent tasks.
risks.reasoning: Category 1 Infrastructure bottleneck designation provides strong signal, and Private Cloud complexity typically causes 2-4 week environment delays. Medium impact as delays are recoverable but compress testing windows. Mitigation possible through proactive assessment.

riskDescription.context: Resolved risk 856 stated 'Integration with live Data Hub APIs is still pending' and noted 'Performance and NFR issues will only become visible after integration', with resolution date of June 29, 2026 (EMS - Risks)
riskDescription.condition: If performance and NFR validation has not been completed during Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026)
riskDescription.consequence: Performance degradation or NFR failures may surface during UAT (June 16-30, 2026), requiring rework and extending UAT beyond scheduled completion date of June 30, 2026

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate Data Hub API performance and NFR requirements during Development and Testing phase with load testing by June 10, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of performance issues in UAT, engage infrastructure team and implement performance tuning workaround within 72 hours.
risks.reasoning: Risk marked resolved but description indicates performance validation may be incomplete. Medium impact as performance issues are recoverable but require rework time. Rated Possible as resolution may have included validation, but uncertainty remains.

riskDescription.context: All risks owned by Engineering Manager Saitej Ballav, with no Delivery Manager, no QA Manager, and BA role marked 'NA' for a Category 1 project (EMS - Risks, Resources, Project Categorization)
riskDescription.condition: If Delivery Manager and QA Manager are not assigned or responsibilities are not distributed by April 1, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: Decision bottlenecks and delayed escalations will slow issue resolution during Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026), increasing schedule risk and preventing adequate quality oversight

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Assign Delivery Manager and QA Manager or distribute responsibilities with backup coverage by April 1, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should key-person become unavailable, activate cross-trained backup resource and escalate to leadership for interim assignment within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Single point of dependency already exists with all project management, technical leadership, and quality oversight concentrated in one person. Medium impact as bottlenecks slow but do not halt progress. Category 1 complexity increases likelihood of overwhelming single owner.

riskDescription.context: BA role marked 'NA' with no Business Analyst assigned during Build + SIT stage when requirements clarification and user story refinement are critical (EMS - Resources)
riskDescription.condition: If BA role remains unfilled through Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026)
riskDescription.consequence: Requirements ambiguity and user story gaps will cause rework during development and testing, reducing sprint velocity and potentially delaying Development and Testing completion beyond June 15, 2026

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Assign Business Analyst or designate developer for requirements clarification with client touchpoints by April 1, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon requirements ambiguity causing rework, conduct emergency requirements workshop with client and document acceptance criteria within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: BA absence is confirmed during stage requiring requirements support. Medium impact as gaps cause rework and velocity reduction but can be partially mitigated through developer-client interaction. Likely as no BA assignment is planned.

riskDescription.condition: If Category 1 governance cadence including weekly executive reviews and risk reviews is not established by March 31, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: Issues will escalate to critical severity before detection, preventing proactive intervention for scope changes, milestone slippage, and resource constraints during critical delivery phases

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish Category 1 governance cadence with weekly executive reviews and risk tracking by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon critical issue detection without prior escalation, activate daily governance reviews and steering committee involvement within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Governance gap already exists - Category 1 classification requires enhanced oversight but none is documented. Medium impact as absence prevents early intervention but does not directly cause failure. Very likely as no governance structure is in place.

riskDescription.context: Go-Green Plan field is empty despite Category 1 classification, active scope change risk, Infrastructure bottleneck, and aggressive milestone timelines (EMS - RAG, Project Categorization, Risks)
riskDescription.condition: If Go-Green Plan addressing scope change management, Infrastructure readiness, and milestone recovery is not developed by March 31, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: No proactive improvement roadmap will exist to address known risks and bottlenecks, increasing likelihood of reactive crisis management during Development and Testing phase (June 1-15, 2026)

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Develop Go-Green Plan with scope control, Infrastructure remediation, and milestone recovery actions by March 31, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Go-Green Plan is not approved by April 7, escalate to project sponsor and activate emergency recovery planning session immediately.
risks.reasoning: Go-Green Plan absence is confirmed despite multiple risk factors requiring proactive planning. Medium impact as absence prevents structured improvement but does not directly cause failure. Very likely as no plan development is indicated.

riskDescription.context: Project end date is December 31, 2026 but SOW end date is November 30, 2026, creating a one-month gap, with Go-Live scheduled for July 15, 2026 and Hypercare through August 31, 2026 (EMS - Project Details, Milestones)
riskDescription.condition: If milestone slippage causes Go-Live to extend beyond July 15, 2026 by 2-4 weeks
riskDescription.consequence: Hypercare window will compress or extend beyond SOW end date of November 30, 2026, creating contractual ambiguity and potential scope/cost disputes for post-Go-Live support

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Clarify SOW and project end date alignment with client and document Hypercare scope by April 15, 2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should Hypercare extend beyond SOW end date, negotiate contract amendment and communicate revised support timeline to client within one week.
risks.reasoning: One-month buffer exists between SOW end and project end, but multiple upstream risks could consume this buffer. Medium impact as misalignment creates contractual friction but is negotiable. Rated Possible as dependent on cumulative milestone slippage.

riskDescription.condition: If process maturity improvement roadmap is not established by May 1, 2026
